text: The CRP focuses on protecting critical regional infrastructure and highly productive agricultural land through a blend of grey infrastructure upgrades and ecological improvements. Key projects include the West Taieri Contour Channel and bridges upgrade, Outram floodbank seepage mitigation, Riverbank Road stopbank stabilization, and Robson Lagoon flow control structures. The program emphasizes hydraulic capacity, geotechnical robustness, and ecological integration, ensuring both rapid economic stimulus and material risk reduction.
